note: score = killed / (killed + survived + timed_out); invalid and skipped mutants are excluded and listed; an equivalent mutant (no visible behaviour change) shows as a survivor

rows.name: db_step_two
rows.why: debounce counts in steps of two
rows.change: rtl/debounce.sv line 34: `cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;` became `cnt <= cnt + 2'd2;` (debounce counts in steps of two)

rows.name: db_level_cond
rows.why: the count is cleared when the input differs
rows.change: rtl/debounce.sv line 27: `end else if (s == level) begin` became `end else if (s != level && !press) begin` (the count is cleared when the input differs)

rows.name: db_late
rows.why: debounce accepts a level one clock late
rows.change: rtl/debounce.sv line 29: `cnt == CW'(CYCLES - 1)` became `cnt == CW'(CYCLES)` (debounce accepts a level one clock late)

rows.name: db_early
rows.why: debounce accepts a level one clock early
rows.change: rtl/debounce.sv line 29: `cnt == CW'(CYCLES - 1)` became `cnt == CW'(CYCLES - 2)` (debounce accepts a level one clock early)

rows.name: db_reset_level
rows.why: the debounced level resets to 1
rows.change: rtl/debounce.sv line 25: `level <= 1'b0;` became `level <= 1'b1;` (the debounced level resets to 1)

rows.name: db_release_press
rows.why: a release also makes a press
rows.change: rtl/debounce.sv line 32: `press <= s;` became `press <= 1'b1;` (a release also makes a press)

rows.name: reset_duty
rows.why: DUTY resets to 0x41
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 51: `duty    <= 8'h40;` became `duty    <= 8'h41;` (DUTY resets to 0x41)

rows.name: reset_ctrl
rows.why: CTRL resets with DUTY_SRC set
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 52: `ctrl    <= 2'b10;` became `ctrl    <= 2'b11;` (CTRL resets with DUTY_SRC set)

rows.name: up_is_down
rows.why: up subtracts
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 63: `else if (p_up)                     count <= count + 1'b1;` became `else if (p_up)                     count <= count - 1'b1;` (up subtracts)

rows.name: clear_loses_to_up
rows.why: clear loses to up on the same clock
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 62: `else if (p_clear)                  count <= '0;` became `else if (p_clear && !p_up)         count <= '0;` (clear loses to up on the same clock)

rows.name: press_not_counted
rows.why: a down press on the clock of an up press is not counted
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 58: `if (p_down)  n_down  <= n_down + 1'b1;` became `if (p_down && !p_up)  n_down  <= n_down + 1'b1;` (a down press on the clock of an up press is not counted)

rows.name: pwm_le
rows.why: PWM on one phase step too long
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 100: `(phase < duty_eff)` became `(phase <= duty_eff)` (PWM on one phase step too long)

rows.name: pwm_prescale
rows.why: PWM phase advances early
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 94: `if (pre == PW'(PWM_PRESCALE - 1))` became `if (pre == PW'(PWM_PRESCALE - 2))` (PWM phase advances early)

rows.name: duty_src_bit
rows.why: DUTY_SRC read from the wrong CTRL bit
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 45: `wire [7:0] duty_eff = ctrl[0] ? sw[7:0] : duty;` became `wire [7:0] duty_eff = ctrl[1] ? sw[7:0] : duty;` (DUTY_SRC read from the wrong CTRL bit)

rows.name: presses_swap
rows.why: PRESSES up and down fields swapped
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 81: `{8'h0, n_clear, n_down, n_up}` became `{8'h0, n_clear, n_up, n_down}` (PRESSES up and down fields swapped)

rows.name: duty_write_mask
rows.why: DUTY write drops bit 7
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 66: `duty <= win_wdata[7:0];` became `duty <= {1'b0, win_wdata[6:0]};` (DUTY write drops bit 7)

rows.name: inputs_swap
rows.why: INPUTS up and down levels swapped
rows.change: rtl/dimmer_counter.sv line 80: `{13'h0, lv_clear, lv_down, lv_up, sw}` became `{13'h0, lv_clear, lv_up, lv_down, sw}` (INPUTS up and down levels swapped)

rows.name: an_enable
rows.why: DISPLAY_EN no longer darkens the display
rows.change: rtl/sevenseg_scan.sv line 49: `(enable && !blank[k])` became `(enable || !blank[k])` (DISPLAY_EN no longer darkens the display)

rows.name: glyph_A
rows.why: glyph A loses segment a
rows.change: rtl/sevenseg_scan.sv line 33: `4'hA: glyph = 7'b1110111;` became `4'hA: glyph = 7'b1110110;` (glyph A loses segment a)

rows.name: scan_step
rows.why: display scan runs at twice the rate
rows.change: rtl/sevenseg_scan.sv line 48: `scan <= scan + 1'b1;` became `scan <= scan + 2'd2;` (display scan runs at twice the rate)

rows.name: scan_reset_an
rows.why: anodes reset all low
rows.change: rtl/sevenseg_scan.sv line 45: `an   <= '1;` became `an   <= '0;` (anodes reset all low)
